# iosxe_wireless_site_tag (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_site_tag" "example" {
  site_tag_name   = "ST1"
  description     = "My Site Tag"
  ap_join_profile = "default-ap-profile"
  flex_profile    = "default-flex-profile"
  local_site      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_tag_name` (String)

### Optional

- `ap_join_profile` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `flex_profile` (String)
- `local_site` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_site_tag.example "<site_tag_name>"
```
